# ThreadSanitizer suppressions for llcommon (the analysis workflow passes this file when it exists:
# .github/analysis/suppressions/<lib>-tsan.txt; see doc/clean/analysis.md). One reason per entry.
#
# Lock-order inversion between the locks of the two test singletons A and B of tests/llsingleton_test.cpp (lockstatic.h):
# they build each other, so one test nests their locks A->B and another B->A. LLSingleton nests locks only on the main
# thread: another thread takes a singleton's lock briefly, releases it and hands the construction to the main thread
# (llsingleton.h, the wait loop of getInstance). A deadlock needs two threads taking the locks in opposite orders; only
# one thread ever nests them, so the inversion cannot deadlock.
# This covers exactly the lock of LLSingleton<A> and of LLSingleton<B>, the two global-namespace test classes of that
# file. A lock-order inversion between any other singleton's lock and another mutex is still reported.
deadlock:LLSingleton<A>
deadlock:LLSingleton<B>
